units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 28:28">Targ. Is. XXVIII, 28</cite> <he>ומְבַלְבֵּל</he> and mixes up (the grain with the chaff, h. text <cite ref="E00622"><he>המם</he></cite>); a. e.—Part. pass. <he>מְבַלְבַּל</he>.
Bekh. 44ᵃ משום דמְבַלְבְּלָן because they (the white and the black of the eye) are mixed up, v. preced.—Denom. מְבַלְבְּלִיתָא mixture of white and black (h. תְּבַלֻּל, v. preced.).
<cite ref="Chullin 26b:3">Ḥull. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>מִיבַּלְבְּלֵי</he> they (water and wine) mix well.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 9b:4">M. Kat. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>לִבַּלְבֵּל פתורם</he> thy table (meals) be disturbed (by the noise of children).
